contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence on reliability, and answering ops directly: ops claims a chaos experiment (artifact:chaos-fanout-run-7) finished cleanly with zero data loss, but no artifact with that id exists in the available artifact list — the only runbook evidence, artifact:ops-runbook, states the opposite: no chaos experiment has ever been performed against the fan-out worker. That claimed experiment is a phantom datum and cannot retire the retry-storm concern. Meanwhile the unrefuted history stands: two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), and neither artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) nor artifact:perf-report (in-budget p99) exercises retry behavior under downstream degradation. Reliability confidence still requires an actual chaos/fault-injection run against retry fan-out plus evidence the change does not amplify retries; nothing new in this round supplies it.
